title: Quranic verses calling the world a game

tellings.quote: But in the Islamic traditions, there's actual verses that say, "We have set up this world for you as a game, as a pastime, as a sport."

plain: The computer scientist Rizwan Virk, who argues that we may live inside a simulation, tells Michels that the Quran has verses that call the world a game. As he gives them, they say: "We have set up this world for you as a game, as a pastime, as a sport." He reads this as an old tradition hinting that reality is something set up for play, but the words he quotes do not say what kind of game is meant, or who set it up beyond "We".
